title: lg watch sport collector
symptom: The LG Watch Sport does not seem to want to act as collector. The force wear option sometimes connects and works but it is very rare.
fix: The watch may need patching to work as a collector, as described in the xDrip wiki page 'Patching Android Wear devices for use with the G5'.
evidence_quote: The watch may need patching to work as a collector: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/wiki/Patching-Android-Wear-devices-for-use-with-the-G5
